_comment: skill_range is [orange_ends, yellow_ends, green_ends, grey_at] - WoW's real profession skill-up convention. Below orange_ends: guaranteed skill-up (100%). Between orange_ends and yellow_ends: high chance. Between yellow_ends and green_ends: low chance. At/above grey_at: no skill-up at all - the material has nothing left to teach you. All 4 numbers are against the profession's OWN skill level (0-75 for early tier), not against character level. Common/cheap materials (Peacebloom, Copper, Weakstone) grey out early since they're meant to be quickly outgrown; the pricier/rarer early materials (Mageroyal, Rough Iron) stay relevant closer to the 75 cap.  ESSENCE HARVESTING REMOVED (Kyle, 2026-10-31: "I need you to 100% remove essence harvesting from the game..actually delete it..it was a whim idea that we didn't pursue"). The ten essence_* motes are gone outright. The five crystal_* entries stayed, moved to MINING per Kyle: "Crystals can be found in ore veins" - they were always world nodes, and Engineering's recipe ladder is built on them.

upgrade_kit_copper.name: Copper Upgrade Kit

upgrade_kit_copper._source: Kyle, Oct 2026: 'crafting upgrade kits..like a copper upgrade kit let's me upgrade a normal item from normal to improved to refined which boosts stats' - refined into 'white will improve to green with kits, green to blue' (reusing the existing rarity ladder rather than a new tier system) + 'only crafted' (gated to is_crafted items). Later corrected again: 'You use the same kit twice. Like copper kit only upgrades copper stuff' - a kit matches an item by its material_tier tag (entities/item.py, world/upgrade_manager.py), not by a fixed rarity jump, and the SAME Copper kit is used again for the item's next rank once more copper gear exists past Rare. skill_range is null (not a gathered material, never greys out/has nothing to teach - no skill-up relevance at all).

upgrade_kit_bronze._source: Replaces an earlier, incorrect 'Silver Upgrade Kit' (tied to a fixed common->uncommon/uncommon->rare JUMP rather than a material) after Kyle's correction above. Bronze is the only other material_tier real gear exists for right now (Rough Bronze Cuirass/Leggings - data/blacksmithing/recipes.json); a Silver kit has nothing to target since no recipe produces Silver-tier gear yet. Kyle, Oct 2026: 'let's just start with copper and bronze to lvl 75 to test the system' (40 total ores/herbs exist, more material tiers of both kits and gear are coming later - this is deliberately scoped to just the two tiers that already have real recipes). Costs 35 (vs Copper's 15) reflecting 'the cost grows the higher rank materials.'

upgrade_kit_rough_iron.name: Rough Iron Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_rough_iron.description: Iron shims and files for Rough Iron-tier crafted gear.

upgrade_kit_steel.name: Steel Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_steel.description: Precision tools for Steel-tier crafted gear.

upgrade_kit_cotton.name: Cotton Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_cotton.description: Tailor's kit for Cotton-tier crafted cloth gear.

upgrade_kit_hempen.name: Hempen Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_hempen.description: Tailor's kit for Hempen-tier crafted cloth gear.

upgrade_kit_mageweave.name: Mageweave Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_mageweave.description: Fine tailor's kit for Mageweave-tier crafted cloth gear.

upgrade_kit_runecloth.name: Runecloth Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_runecloth.description: Master tailor's kit for Runecloth-tier crafted cloth gear.

vial_empty.name: Empty Vial
vial_empty.description: A small glass vial, stoppered with a cork. Alchemists use these for every potion and elixir they brew.

vial_leaded.name: Leaded Vial
vial_leaded.description: A thicker glass vial lined with lead. Required for higher-potency alchemical concoctions.

vial_crystal.name: Crystal Vial
vial_crystal.description: A precision-cut crystal vial used for master-level alchemical work. Holds reagents without contamination.

parchment.name: Parchment
parchment.description: Dried animal skin scraped smooth. Used to transcribe recipes, inscriptions, and scrolls.

thread_coarse.name: Coarse Thread
thread_coarse.description: Rough linen-spun thread. Used to stitch together basic cloth garments.

thread_fine.name: Fine Thread
thread_fine.description: Smoothly-spun thread for tailoring quality garments. A staple at any tailor supplier.

thread_silken.name: Silken Thread
thread_silken.description: Thread spun from silk. Required for weaving fine cloth garments and enchanted vestments.

dye_mild.name: Mild Dye
dye_mild.description: A basic plant-based dye. Used in tailoring patterns that call for colored cloth.

dye_bright.name: Bright Dye
dye_bright.description: A vivid, fixed dye used to colour mid-grade cloth armor. Does not fade under enchantment.

bleach.name: Bleach
bleach.description: A caustic stripping agent used to whiten cloth and prepare it for dyeing.

flux_weak.name: Weak Flux
flux_weak.description: A crude mineral flux used to help metals flow cleanly during smelting and forging.

flux_medium.name: Medium Flux
flux_medium.description: A refined flux compound for working with iron and steel. Prevents oxidation at the forge.

flux_strong.name: Strong Flux
flux_strong.description: A potent metalworking flux for high-grade alloys. Required by master smiths.

coal.name: Coal
coal.description: Dense black coal that burns hot and long. Required to smelt iron and harder metals.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.description: A flat grinding stone for finishing blade edges. Used in weapon-polishing recipes.

salt.name: Salt
salt.description: Coarse salt used to cure and preserve hides. A fundamental reagent in leatherworking.

tanning_reagent.name: Tanning Reagent
tanning_reagent.description: A chemical solution used to convert raw hides into workable leather.

curing_salt.name: Curing Salt
curing_salt.description: A refined salt compound for curing thick and exotic hides that normal salt cannot treat.

sinew.name: Sinew
sinew.description: Dried animal sinew, used as a binding thread in heavy leather armor construction.

component_string.name: Bowstring
component_string.description: A tightly-twisted sinew and hemp string used on all bows and crossbows.

fletching.name: Fletching
fletching.description: Trimmed bird feathers used to stabilise arrows in flight.

resin.name: Resin
resin.description: Thick tree resin used to seal and waterproof wooden weapons and as a binding agent.

glue.name: Wood Glue
glue.description: Boiled hide glue for jointing wooden components. Used in laminated bows and staves.

herb_stranglekelp.name: Stranglekelp
herb_stranglekelp.description: A ropey strand of coastal kelp, still slick with brine. Alchemists prize it for elixirs that quicken the blood.

herb_khadgar.name: Khadgar's Whisker
herb_khadgar.description: Fine silver filaments that tremble without any wind. Named for the archmage, though nobody agrees why.

herb_firebloom.name: Firebloom
herb_firebloom.description: Petals that hold a dry heat long after cutting. Handle it with gloves; it has scorched more than one careless herbalist.

herb_sungrass.name: Sungrass
herb_sungrass.description: Pale blades that store the day's light and give it back at dusk. A steadying reagent in guardian elixirs.

herb_blindweed.name: Blindweed
herb_blindweed.description: A marsh creeper whose sap clouds the eyes on contact. Diluted properly, it sharpens them instead.

upgrade_kit_iron.name: Iron Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_iron.description: Iron shims, rivets and a tin of grinding paste. Reworks iron-forged gear into something a smith will admit to having made.

crystal_quartz.name: Rough Quartz
crystal_quartz.description: Cloudy, common, and the first thing every harvester learns to pry loose. Prised out of an ore vein alongside the metal.

crystal_azure.name: Azure Crystal
crystal_azure.description: Pale blue and cold to hold. Rings faintly when struck. Prised out of an ore vein alongside the metal.

crystal_emberglass.name: Emberglass
crystal_emberglass.description: Fire-born glass, red through the middle, sharp enough to cut a glove. Prised out of an ore vein alongside the metal.

crystal_tideglass.name: Tideglass
crystal_tideglass.description: Sea-green and faintly wet to the touch however long it has been dry. Prised out of an ore vein alongside the metal.

crystal_voidglass.name: Voidglass
crystal_voidglass.description: Black, flawless, and noticeably heavier than it looks. Engineers pay well. Prised out of an ore vein alongside the metal.

upgrade_kit_resonant.name: Resonant Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_resonant.description: Azure crystal shims and a wound coil. Re-tunes crystal-bound gear until it sings true.

part_copper_bolts.name: Handful of Copper Bolts
part_copper_bolts.description: Twenty-odd bolts, near enough the same size.

part_copper_tube.name: Copper Tube
part_copper_tube.description: Drawn and seamed by hand. The seam is the weak point.

part_wooden_stock.name: Shaped Stock
part_wooden_stock.description: Cut to the shoulder, sanded, not yet fitted.

part_flint_striker.name: Flint Striker
part_flint_striker.description: Strikes a spark nine times in ten.

part_copper_modulator.name: Copper Modulator
part_copper_modulator.description: A coil and a cage. Smooths a mote's output into something usable.

part_glass_lens.name: Ground Lens
part_glass_lens.description: Ground, polished, and checked against the sun.

part_bronze_framework.name: Bronze Framework
part_bronze_framework.description: The skeleton most of the bigger work is built onto.

part_bronze_tube.name: Bronze Tube
part_bronze_tube.description: Seamless, unlike its copper predecessor. Holds pressure.

part_coiled_spring.name: Coiled Spring
part_coiled_spring.description: Wound tight and tempered. Do not uncage it on the bench.

part_sight_glass.name: Sight Glass
part_sight_glass.description: Two lenses and a tube. The beginning of a scope.

part_azure_coil.name: Azure Coil
part_azure_coil.description: Crystal wound in wire. Hums when something nearby does.

part_iron_casing.name: Iron Casing
part_iron_casing.description: Heavy, plain, and strong enough to contain a mistake.

part_steel_barrel.name: Steel Barrel
part_steel_barrel.description: Bored straight, which is harder than it sounds.

part_unstable_trigger.name: Unstable Trigger
part_unstable_trigger.description: Hair-fine. Engineers carry these in a padded tin.

part_precision_sight.name: Precision Sight
part_precision_sight.description: Etched with range marks nobody has verified.

part_resonant_core.name: Resonant Core
part_resonant_core.description: The crystal and the essence finally agreeing to work together.

part_void_regulator.name: Void Regulator
part_void_regulator.description: Keeps umbral essence doing what it is told. Mostly.

scope_crude.name: Crude Scope
scope_crude.description: Fits to a gun or crossbow. Steadier than a squint.

scope_standard.name: Standard Scope
scope_standard.description: Fits to a gun or crossbow. Steadier than a squint.

scope_precision.name: Precision Scope
scope_precision.description: Fits to a gun or crossbow. Steadier than a squint.

scope_resonant.name: Resonant Scope
scope_resonant.description: Fits to a gun or crossbow. Steadier than a squint.

nock_horn.name: Horn Nock
nock_horn.description: A shaped horn tip that seats the string true. Stops the limb fraying itself.

limbs_laminated.name: Laminated Limbs
limbs_laminated.description: Three woods glued against the grain. Springs back harder than any one of them would.

pin_truesight.name: Truesight Pin
pin_truesight.description: A filed brass pin set above the grip. Takes the guesswork out of a long shot.

limbs_heartwood.name: Heartwood Limbs
limbs_heartwood.description: Cut from the dense centre of an ironbark. Heavy to draw, brutal to be hit by.

meat_stringy.name: Stringy Meat
meat_stringy.description: Tough, lean and not much of it. Boil it long enough and it gives in.

meat_lean.name: Lean Cut
meat_lean.description: Honest meat off an honest animal.

meat_thick.name: Thick Cut
meat_thick.description: A proper joint. Heavy enough to notice in a pack.

meat_rich.name: Rich Cut
meat_rich.description: Marbled and dark. Worth the weight.

meat_prime.name: Prime Cut
meat_prime.description: The piece a cook puts aside before anybody else sees the carcass.

part_tide_seal.name: Tideglass Seal
part_tide_seal.description: Ground tideglass set in a bronze ring. Keeps water out of things that mind.

ore_gold.name: Gold Ore
ore_gold.description: Soft, heavy and worth more melted than swung.

ore_mithril.name: Mithril Ore
ore_mithril.description: Light for its strength. Smiths talk about it the way cooks talk about salt.

ore_truesilver.name: Truesilver Ore
ore_truesilver.description: Holds an edge and will not tarnish. Expensive for both reasons.

ore_thorium.name: Thorium Ore
ore_thorium.description: Takes a brutal heat to work and pays it back.

ore_dark_iron.name: Dark Iron Ore
ore_dark_iron.description: Drinks heat instead of taking it. A normal forge will not touch it.

ore_elementium.name: Elementium Ore
ore_elementium.description: Will not sit still in the crucible.

ore_dreamsteel.name: Dreamsteel Ore
ore_dreamsteel.description: Smiths disagree about what it looked like the day before.

ore_bronze_vein.name: Bronze Vein Ore
ore_bronze_vein.description: Copper and tin grown together in the rock, already half alloyed.

ore_living_copper.name: Living Copper Ore
ore_living_copper.description: The seam has moved since it was surveyed. Twice.

ore_verdant_iron.name: Verdant Iron Ore
ore_verdant_iron.description: Green through the break, and no smith has agreed on why.

ore_frostveined_tin.name: Frostveined Tin Ore
ore_frostveined_tin.description: White lines through the grey that do not melt on the palm.

ore_felslag.name: Felslag Ore
ore_felslag.description: The waste left by something that was smelting down here first.

ore_bloodiron.name: Bloodiron Ore
ore_bloodiron.description: Rusts the moment it is cut, in a colour rust does not come in.

ore_deepearth.name: Deepearth Ore
ore_deepearth.description: Comes up warm and takes a week to stop being warm.

ore_ashen_steel.name: Ashen Steel Ore
ore_ashen_steel.description: Already steel in the ground, which should not be possible.

ore_frostforged_silver.name: Frostforged Silver Ore
ore_frostforged_silver.description: Tempered by cold rather than heat, somewhere, by something.

ore_sunforged_gold.name: Sunforged Gold Ore
ore_sunforged_gold.description: Too bright to work by lamplight. Smiths do it at dawn.

ore_nightshard.name: Nightshard Ore
ore_nightshard.description: Breaks into splinters that are hard to look directly at.

ore_voidstone.name: Voidstone Ore
ore_voidstone.description: Takes no shine at all, at any angle, under any light.

ore_stormveined.name: Stormveined Ore
ore_stormveined.description: Hums faintly. Nobody leaves it near a compass.

ore_sylvanite.name: Sylvanite Ore
ore_sylvanite.description: Found tangled through roots, as though the tree put it there.

ore_molten_coreite.name: Molten Coreite Ore
ore_molten_coreite.description: Carried in stone buckets. Nobody has tried a sack twice.

ore_abyssal_iron.name: Abyssal Iron Ore
ore_abyssal_iron.description: Pulled from below the level where the lamps stop helping.

ore_ebonrend.name: Ebonrend Ore
ore_ebonrend.description: The seam is a tear rather than a vein.

ore_sunderedsteel.name: Sunderedsteel Ore
ore_sunderedsteel.description: Shattered in the ground and healed back wrong.

ore_starforged_iron.name: Starforged Iron Ore
ore_starforged_iron.description: Fell, rather than formed. The seam is a crater.

ore_astral_platinum.name: Astral Platinum Ore
ore_astral_platinum.description: Weighs differently depending on the hour.

ore_chronium.name: Chronium Ore
ore_chronium.description: Older at one end of the bar than the other, measurably.

ore_titansteel.name: Titansteel Ore
ore_titansteel.description: A single bar is a two-man carry and worth the second man.

ore_wyrmscale.name: Wyrmscale Ore
ore_wyrmscale.description: Lies in overlapping plates, like something shed it.

ore_cataclysmic.name: Cataclysmic Ore
ore_cataclysmic.description: Only found where the ground gave way during the Integration.

ore_primordium.name: Primordium Ore
ore_primordium.description: Older than the rock it is sitting in.

ore_worldheart.name: Worldheart Ore
ore_worldheart.description: From deep enough that nobody has agreed which world.

wood_silverbark_tree.name: Silverbark Log
wood_silverbark_tree.description: Pale wood off a pale tree. Takes a finish beautifully.

wood_goldenleaf_tree.name: Goldenleaf Log
wood_goldenleaf_tree.description: Drops its leaves gold and keeps dropping them all year.

wood_redbark_tree.name: Redbark Log
wood_redbark_tree.description: Red through the grain. The sap stains and the stain stays.

wood_sapglow_stump.name: Sapglow Stump
wood_sapglow_stump.description: The cut end still shows light an hour after felling.

wood_marshwillow.name: Marshwillow Log
wood_marshwillow.description: Waterlogged through and somehow not rotten.

wood_duskwood_stump.name: Duskwood Stump
wood_duskwood_stump.description: Dark enough that a joint in it is invisible.

wood_nightshade_stump.name: Nightshade Stump
wood_nightshade_stump.description: Has to be stripped before it can be worked, carefully.

wood_thornveil_stump.name: Thornveil Stump
wood_thornveil_stump.description: The thorns grow inward as well as out.

wood_bloodroot_stump.name: Bloodroot Stump
wood_bloodroot_stump.description: The root, not the trunk. Harder than the trunk.

wood_bloodwood_tree.name: Bloodwood Log
wood_bloodwood_tree.description: Warm in the hand, and the warmth does not come from the sun.

wood_felbark_tree.name: Felbark Log
wood_felbark_tree.description: Grew wrong somewhere and the wrongness is in the grain.

wood_moonpetal_tree.name: Moonpetal Log
wood_moonpetal_tree.description: Cut at night, by people who insist it matters.

wood_emberwood_stump.name: Emberwood Stump
wood_emberwood_stump.description: Burns slowly and reluctantly, which is why it is valued.

wood_frostheart_tree.name: Frostheart Log
wood_frostheart_tree.description: Grew under ice. The rings are almost too close to count.

wood_ebonthorn_stump.name: Ebonthorn Stump
wood_ebonthorn_stump.description: Black all the way through, thorns included.

wood_starleaf_tree.name: Starleaf Log
wood_starleaf_tree.description: Flecked through with something that catches light from inside.

wood_stormoak_tree.name: Stormoak Log
wood_stormoak_tree.description: Struck and survived. The scar runs the whole length.

wood_sunheart_stump.name: Sunheart Stump
wood_sunheart_stump.description: Warm to the touch on the shaded side.

wood_voidwood_tree.name: Voidwood Log
wood_voidwood_tree.description: Casts a shadow in the wrong direction and nobody enjoys it.

wood_dreamwillow.name: Dreamwillow Log
wood_dreamwillow.description: Carvers report finishing work they do not remember starting.

wood_wyrmscak_tree.name: Wyrmscak Log
wood_wyrmscak_tree.description: Something large slept against this trunk for a long time.

wood_astral_birch.name: Astral Birch Log
wood_astral_birch.description: The bark peels in sheets that hold their curl.

wood_sylvanheart_tree.name: Sylvanheart Log
wood_sylvanheart_tree.description: Still putting out leaves, cut and stacked.

wood_radiant_ashenwood_tree.name: Radiant Ashenwood Log
wood_radiant_ashenwood_tree.description: Grey, and brighter than grey has any business being.

wood_molten_ironwood_stump.name: Molten Ironwood Stump
wood_molten_ironwood_stump.description: Hard as the name promises and twice as heavy.

wood_abysswood_tree.name: Abysswood Log
wood_abysswood_tree.description: Grew where there is no light to grow by.

wood_chronoak_stump.name: Chronoak Stump
wood_chronoak_stump.description: One ring is a century. The stump is a section of one ring.

wood_starforged_oak.name: Starforged Oak Log
wood_starforged_oak.description: Something came down through the canopy and the tree kept going.

wood_sunderedwood_stump.name: Sunderedwood Stump
wood_sunderedwood_stump.description: Split to the root and grown back around the split.

wood_cataclysm_root_stump.name: Cataclysm Root Stump
wood_cataclysm_root_stump.description: Only found where the ground moved during the Integration.

wood_genesis_bough_tree.name: Genesis Bough
wood_genesis_bough_tree.description: Puts out new growth on the woodpile, in the dark, in winter.

wood_worldbranch_tree.name: Worldbranch Log
wood_worldbranch_tree.description: A branch with no tree anybody has found.

wood_worldtree_heartwood_stump.name: Worldtree Heartwood
wood_worldtree_heartwood_stump.description: From a tree that predates the forest around it.

upgrade_kit_cragscale.name: Cragscale Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_cragscale.description: Reinforced tools for Cragscale-tier crafted gear.

upgrade_kit_stormscale.name: Stormscale Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_stormscale.description: Reinforced tools for Stormscale-tier crafted gear.

upgrade_kit_stonebound.name: Stonebound Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_stonebound.description: Reinforced tools for Stonebound-tier crafted gear.

upgrade_kit_spidersilk.name: Spidersilk Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_spidersilk.description: Reinforced tools for Spidersilk-tier crafted gear.

upgrade_kit_dusk_velvet.name: Dusk Velvet Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_dusk_velvet.description: Reinforced tools for Dusk Velvet-tier crafted gear.

upgrade_kit_gossamer.name: Gossamer Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_gossamer.description: Reinforced tools for Gossamer-tier crafted gear.

upgrade_kit_thistledown.name: Thistledown Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_thistledown.description: Reinforced tools for Thistledown-tier crafted gear.

herb_wild_steelbloom.name: Wild Steelbloom
herb_wild_steelbloom.description: A grey-petalled bloom that grows through cracked stone, hard as the rock it splits.

herb_purple_lotus.name: Purple Lotus
herb_purple_lotus.description: Deep violet petals, cool to the touch. Alchemists pay well and ask no questions.

herb_golden_sansam.name: Golden Sansam
herb_golden_sansam.description: A pale root under a crown of gold leaf. It tastes of nothing and mends almost anything.

herb_dreamfoil.name: Dreamfoil
herb_dreamfoil.description: The leaves blur at the edges when you look straight at them.

herb_icecap.name: Icecap
herb_icecap.description: A white bloom that keeps its own frost in high summer.

herb_black_lotus.name: Black Lotus
herb_black_lotus.description: Petals that drink the light. Perhaps a dozen are picked in a season, and every alchemist in the world wants one.

crystal_arcane.name: Arcane Crystal
crystal_arcane.description: A shard of raw magic found packed in the richest thorium. It hums against the pick.

bar_arcanite.name: Arcanite Bar
bar_arcanite.description: Thorium and raw magic, argued into one metal. It is never quite still.

upgrade_kit_weakstone.name: Weakstone Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_weakstone.description: Plates and rivets for reworking weakstone gear.

upgrade_kit_tin.name: Tin Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_tin.description: Plates and rivets for reworking tin gear.

upgrade_kit_bronze_vein.name: Bronze Vein Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_bronze_vein.description: Plates and rivets for reworking bronze vein gear.

upgrade_kit_living_copper.name: Living Copper Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_living_copper.description: Plates and rivets for reworking living copper gear.

upgrade_kit_frostveined_tin.name: Frostveined Tin Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_frostveined_tin.description: Plates and rivets for reworking frostveined tin gear.

upgrade_kit_verdant_iron.name: Verdant Iron Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_verdant_iron.description: Plates and rivets for reworking verdant iron gear.

upgrade_kit_felslag.name: Felslag Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_felslag.description: Plates and rivets for reworking felslag gear.

upgrade_kit_bloodiron.name: Bloodiron Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_bloodiron.description: Plates and rivets for reworking bloodiron gear.

upgrade_kit_deepearth.name: Deepearth Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_deepearth.description: Plates and rivets for reworking deepearth gear.

upgrade_kit_dark_iron.name: Dark Iron Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_dark_iron.description: Plates and rivets for reworking dark iron gear.

upgrade_kit_truesilver.name: Truesilver Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_truesilver.description: Plates and rivets for reworking truesilver gear.

upgrade_kit_thorium.name: Thorium Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_thorium.description: Plates and rivets for reworking thorium gear.

upgrade_kit_ashen_steel.name: Ashen Steel Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_ashen_steel.description: Plates and rivets for reworking ashen steel gear.

upgrade_kit_arcanite.name: Arcanite Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_arcanite.description: Plates and rivets for reworking arcanite gear.

upgrade_kit_elementium.name: Elementium Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_elementium.description: Plates and rivets for reworking elementium gear.

upgrade_kit_mithril.name: Mithril Upgrade Kit
upgrade_kit_mithril.description: Plates and rivets for reworking mithril gear.

stick_green.name: Green Shaft
stick_green.description: Cut this season. It still has a little give in it.

stick_seasoned.name: Seasoned Shaft
stick_seasoned.description: Dried slowly in the dark until it stopped arguing.

stick_hardened.name: Hardened Shaft
stick_hardened.description: Fire-cured and planed true. It will not warp again.

stick_lacquered.name: Lacquered Shaft
stick_lacquered.description: Sealed against damp and rot, and it rings when struck.

stick_banded.name: Banded Shaft
stick_banded.description: Ringed with metal at the stress points so it does not split.

stick_ironbound.name: Ironbound Shaft
stick_ironbound.description: Wrapped end to end. Heavy in the hand, and it will outlast you.

fiber_braided.name: Braided Fiber
fiber_braided.description: Three strands worked together; it takes a load without creaking.

fiber_corded.name: Corded Fiber
fiber_corded.description: Twisted tight and tarred. Rope-makers would recognise the work.

fiber_warded.name: Warded Fiber
fiber_warded.description: Steeped in something that keeps the rot and the rats off.

pages_vellum.name: Vellum Pages
pages_vellum.description: Thin enough to read through, strong enough to argue with.

pages_leafed.name: Leafed Pages
pages_leafed.description: Pressed between boards until every sheet lies flat.

pages_gilded.name: Gilded Pages
pages_gilded.description: Edged in gold leaf. Mostly for show, but the show matters.

meat_marbled.name: Marbled Cut
meat_marbled.description: Fat laced right through it. It bastes itself.

meat_aged.name: Aged Cut
meat_aged.description: Hung in the cold until it turned dark and sweet.

meat_select.name: Select Cut
meat_select.description: The one piece a butcher keeps back and does not put on the board.

cook_flour.name: Flour
cook_flour.description: Milled fine. Thickens a stew, wraps a pie.

cook_honey.name: Wild Honey
cook_honey.description: Dark, and it does not pour so much as give way.

cook_spice.name: Hot Spices
cook_spice.description: A twist of paper. Do not touch your eyes.

cook_mushroom.name: Cellar Mushrooms
cook_mushroom.description: Grown in the dark on purpose.

cook_cheese.name: Sharp Cheese
cook_cheese.description: Hard, yellow, and older than the innkeeper admits.

cook_ale.name: Cooking Ale
cook_ale.description: Not for drinking. People drink it.

cook_fruit.name: Orchard Fruit
cook_fruit.description: Whatever was ripe. Bruised on one side.

cook_water.name: Fresh Water
cook_water.description: From the well. For the pot, not the road.

cook_bread.name: Bread
cook_bread.description: A plain loaf. Half of what a kitchen makes starts here.

cook_stock.name: Soup Stock
cook_stock.description: Roots boiled down until the water is worth something.

fish_brilliant_smallfish.name: Brilliant Smallfish
fish_brilliant_smallfish.description: Silver, quick, and gone the moment your shadow crosses the water.

fish_slitherskin_mackerel.name: Slitherskin Mackerel
fish_slitherskin_mackerel.description: Oily and plentiful. The first fish anybody catches.

fish_longjaw_mud_snapper.name: Longjaw Mud Snapper
fish_longjaw_mud_snapper.description: Lives in the silt and tastes of it until you soak it.

fish_bristle_whisker_catfish.name: Bristle Whisker Catfish
fish_bristle_whisker_catfish.description: All mouth and whiskers. Fights like a much bigger fish.

fish_loch_frenzy.name: Loch Frenzy
fish_loch_frenzy.description: Teeth first. Mind your fingers getting the hook out.

fish_rainbow_fin_albacore.name: Rainbow Fin Albacore
fish_rainbow_fin_albacore.description: The fins catch the light. The meat is firm and clean.

fish_sagefish.name: Sagefish
fish_sagefish.description: Shamans say eating one clears the head. Cooks agree.

fish_oily_blackmouth.name: Oily Blackmouth
fish_oily_blackmouth.description: Too greasy to eat. Alchemists press it for the oil.

fish_deviate_fish.name: Deviate Fish
fish_deviate_fish.description: Something in the water has got into it. Cook it thoroughly.

fish_firefin_snapper.name: Firefin Snapper
fish_firefin_snapper.description: Warm to the touch for an hour after it is landed.

fish_rockscale_cod.name: Rockscale Cod
fish_rockscale_cod.description: Scales like slate. Blunts a knife and is worth it.

fish_mithril_head_trout.name: Mithril Head Trout
fish_mithril_head_trout.description: The skull shines like the metal. Nobody knows why.

fish_greater_sagefish.name: Greater Sagefish
fish_greater_sagefish.description: Older, deeper, and harder to fool than its cousin.

fish_spotted_yellowtail.name: Spotted Yellowtail
fish_spotted_yellowtail.description: A strong swimmer from warm water. Good on a grill.

fish_stonescale_eel.name: Stonescale Eel
fish_stonescale_eel.description: Comes up at night. The skin gives a grey oil that hardens.

fish_redgill.name: Redgill
fish_redgill.description: Bright as a wound. Sweet under the skin.

fish_nightfin_snapper.name: Nightfin Snapper
fish_nightfin_snapper.description: Only bites after dark. Eating one settles the mind.

fish_sunscale_salmon.name: Sunscale Salmon
fish_sunscale_salmon.description: Only bites by day. Runs upriver gold.

fish_winter_squid.name: Winter Squid
fish_winter_squid.description: Cold-water catch. Tough until you beat it flat.

fish_glossy_mightfish.name: Glossy Mightfish
fish_glossy_mightfish.description: Heavy, slow and stubborn. Takes two hands to land.

fish_darkclaw_lobster.name: Darkclaw Lobster
fish_darkclaw_lobster.description: Not a fish. Nobody who has eaten one cares.

fish_lightning_eel.name: Lightning Eel
fish_lightning_eel.description: Wear gloves. Wear them afterwards too.

oil_blackmouth.name: Blackmouth Oil
oil_blackmouth.description: Pressed from Oily Blackmouth. Slick, dark, and it never quite washes off.

oil_fire.name: Fire Oil
oil_fire.description: Rendered from Firefin Snapper. Keep it away from lamps.

oil_stonescale.name: Stonescale Oil
oil_stonescale.description: From the skin of a Stonescale Eel. Sets hard on whatever it touches.

gem_malachite.name: Malachite
gem_malachite.description: A soft green stone with darker bands running through it. The first gem most miners ever find. Found in Copper veins.

gem_tigerseye.name: Tigerseye
gem_tigerseye.description: Brown and gold, with a line of light that slides across it as you turn it. Found in Copper veins.

gem_rock_crystal.name: Rock Crystal
gem_rock_crystal.description: A clear six-sided point, worth little, but it takes a clean edge. Found in Weakstone veins.

gem_bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
gem_bloodstone.description: Dark green, spotted red as if something bled on it and it never washed off. Found in Rough Iron veins.

gem_moss_agate.name: Moss Agate
gem_moss_agate.description: A cloudy stone with what looks like moss growing inside it. It is not moss. Found in Tin veins.

gem_shadowgem.name: Shadowgem
gem_shadowgem.description: Smoke-dark and faintly violet. Jewellers like it; lamps do not seem to light it. Found in Tin veins.

gem_lesser_moonstone.name: Lesser Moonstone
gem_lesser_moonstone.description: Pale as milk with a blue light somewhere inside it that is never quite where you look. Found in Silver veins.

gem_carnelian.name: Carnelian
gem_carnelian.description: A warm orange-red stone, smooth as wax. Found in Bronze Vein veins.

gem_jet.name: Jet
gem_jet.description: Black, light in the hand, and warm to the touch. Coal that took its time. Found in Coal veins.

gem_honey_amber.name: Honey Amber
gem_honey_amber.description: Gold and clear, with something small and green caught in it. Found in Living Copper veins.

gem_jade.name: Jade
gem_jade.description: Even green all the way through, cool, and heavier than it looks. Found in Iron veins.

gem_citrine.name: Citrine
gem_citrine.description: Clear yellow, the colour of weak tea held up to a window. Found in Iron veins.

gem_rime_opal.name: Rime Opal
gem_rime_opal.description: White, with frost-blue cracks that never spread and never close. Found in Frostveined Tin veins.

gem_topaz.name: Topaz
gem_topaz.description: Golden, hard, and cut by nature into something close to a jewel already. Found in Gold veins.

gem_peridot.name: Verdant Peridot
gem_peridot.description: Bright olive green. Found where iron has been lying under old forest. Found in Verdant Iron veins.

gem_aquamarine.name: Aquamarine
gem_aquamarine.description: Pale sea-blue and long in the crystal. Sailors pay over the odds for it. Found in Mithril veins.

gem_star_ruby.name: Star Ruby
gem_star_ruby.description: Deep red, with a six-pointed star that sits on its surface under any light. Found in Mithril veins.

gem_blue_sapphire.name: Blue Sapphire
gem_blue_sapphire.description: A blue so deep it looks black until the light gets behind it. Found in Thorium veins.

gem_large_opal.name: Large Opal
gem_large_opal.description: White, and full of small fires in every colour that move when you do. Found in Thorium veins.

gem_huge_emerald.name: Huge Emerald
gem_huge_emerald.description: Too big to be real, and real. Vivid green and flawed in the way all true ones are. Found in Truesilver veins.

gem_felfire_shard.name: Felfire Shard
gem_felfire_shard.description: A splinter of green fire that set hard. It is warm, and it should not be. Found in Felslag veins.

gem_heartsblood_garnet.name: Heartsblood Garnet
gem_heartsblood_garnet.description: Dark red and round as a drop. Miners will not put one in a pocket over the heart. Found in Bloodiron veins.

gem_deepearth_geode.name: Deepearth Geode
gem_deepearth_geode.description: A dull grey lump that splits to show a hollow lined with violet teeth. Found in Deepearth veins.

gem_black_diamond.name: Black Diamond
gem_black_diamond.description: A diamond that swallowed the forge it grew beside. Black, with a red spark deep in. Found in Dark Iron veins.

gem_truesilver_zircon.name: Moonsilver Zircon
gem_truesilver_zircon.description: Colourless and brighter than glass has any right to be. Found in Truesilver veins.

gem_cinder_agate.name: Cinder Agate
gem_cinder_agate.description: Grey bands and orange bands, and the orange ones are still faintly alight. Found in Ashen Steel veins.

gem_elementium_prism.name: Elementium Prism
gem_elementium_prism.description: A prism in four colours that will not mix: flame, water, leaf and cloud. Found in Elementium veins.

gem_glacier_sapphire.name: Glacier Sapphire
gem_glacier_sapphire.description: Ice blue. It fogs when you breathe on it and takes a long time to clear. Found in Frostforged Silver veins.

gem_sylvan_emerald.name: Sylvan Emerald
gem_sylvan_emerald.description: Green shot through with fine gold, like a leaf with the sun behind it. Found in Sylvanite veins.

gem_magma_ruby.name: Magma Ruby
gem_magma_ruby.description: Red going to orange, and something moves in it as slow as cooling rock. Found in Molten Coreite veins.

gem_sunstone.name: Sunstone
gem_sunstone.description: Gold and orange, with rays in it. It casts a shadow of its own at noon. Found in Sunforged Gold veins.

gem_nightshard_onyx.name: Nightshard Onyx
gem_nightshard_onyx.description: A black splinter edged in violet. It is always the last thing in the room you see. Found in Nightshard veins.

gem_abyssal_pearlstone.name: Abyssal Pearlstone
gem_abyssal_pearlstone.description: A dark teal bead with a pearl's sheen, grown where no oyster ever was. Found in Abyssal Iron veins.

gem_void_amethyst.name: Void Amethyst
gem_void_amethyst.description: Deep purple round a centre that is not a colour at all. Found in Voidstone veins.

gem_stormglass.name: Stormglass
gem_stormglass.description: Clear, with a fork of lightning caught in the middle of striking. Found in Stormveined veins.

gem_ebon_spinel.name: Ebon Spinel
gem_ebon_spinel.description: A black eight-sided stone that throws back crimson from any light. Found in Ebonrend veins.

gem_sundered_tourmaline.name: Sundered Tourmaline
gem_sundered_tourmaline.description: Half pink, half green, and cracked clean along the line between. Found in Sunderedsteel veins.

gem_starfall_diamond.name: Starfall Diamond
gem_starfall_diamond.description: A white diamond with points of light in it that are in the right places for the sky. Found in Starforged Iron veins.

gem_astral_moonstone.name: Astral Moonstone
gem_astral_moonstone.description: Silver-blue, with a crescent of light that waxes and wanes with the month. Found in Astral Platinum veins.

gem_hourglass_topaz.name: Hourglass Topaz
gem_hourglass_topaz.description: Amber, with a shape like an hourglass in it. The sand in it runs upward. Found in Chronium veins.

gem_titans_eye.name: Titan's Eye
gem_titans_eye.description: Steel blue with a ring of gold round a dark centre. It does not blink first. Found in Titansteel veins.

gem_wyrmheart_ruby.name: Wyrmheart Ruby
gem_wyrmheart_ruby.description: Crimson, faceted like scales, and warm enough to keep a hand from stiffening. Found in Wyrmscale veins.

gem_cataclysm_opal.name: Cataclysm Opal
gem_cataclysm_opal.description: Black, split by fissures of red and orange that are wider than they were yesterday. Found in Cataclysmic veins.

gem_dreamers_jade.name: Dreamer's Jade
gem_dreamers_jade.description: Misty green. People who carry one report sleeping well and remembering nothing. Found in Dreamsteel veins.

gem_primordial_amber.name: Primordial Amber
gem_primordial_amber.description: Old amber with a coiled thing in it that has no living relatives. Found in Primordium veins.

gem_worldheart_crystal.name: Worldheart Crystal
gem_worldheart_crystal.description: Green and gold, and it beats. Slowly. About once for every twenty of yours. Found in Worldheart veins.

gem_fire_opal.name: Fire Opal
gem_fire_opal.description: Orange and red, lit from inside like a coal seen through a curtain. Found in Bloodiron veins.

gem_azure_diamond.name: Skyglass Diamond
gem_azure_diamond.description: Flawless and faintly blue. The stone every apprentice is told they will never cut. Found in Thorium veins.

gem_pyrite_star.name: Fool's Star
gem_pyrite_star.description: A cluster of brassy cubes. Not gold. Jewellers buy it anyway, for the shapes. Found in Gold veins.

gem_prismatic_shard.name: Prismatic Shard
gem_prismatic_shard.description: A long shard that breaks any light into every colour and hands them back in order. Found in Elementium veins.

gem_azurite.name: Azurite
gem_azurite.description: A deep blue crust with paler swirls, scraped off the inside of iron-stained rock. Found in Rough Iron veins.

gem_garnet.name: Garnet
gem_garnet.description: Small, round and dark red. Common enough that miners keep them in a jar. Found in Bronze Vein veins.

gem_amethyst.name: Amethyst
gem_amethyst.description: A clear purple point that darkens toward the tip, grown in the cracks of black iron. Found in Dark Iron veins.
